rundown: Vipers beat Blue 93-76 at Paycom Center in Oklahoma City, OK in front of 8,036. Vipers led 56-39 at the half and never looked back. The 1st quarter decided it: Vipers won it 27-17.
Leading the way — Vipers: Julian Phillips 22 pts; Dajuan Harris 12 ast; Tyler Smith 10 reb. Blue: Robert McCray V 14 pts, 5 ast; Andrew Holifield 10 reb.
Where Vipers won it: they shot 41% to 39%, had 28 assists to 15 and turned it over 17 times to 26.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 10, 11:59 AM ET. It had Vipers 60% and Blue 40%, projecting Vipers 112.2 – Blue 109.4 (221.6 total, Vipers by 2.9).

Final: Vipers 93 – Blue 76. Right winner: it had Vipers at 60%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Vipers came in with a 13% above average attack and a 12% leakier than average defense (0-1, 116 scored and 120 allowed a game over 1 games), worth about 13 and 13 games of evidence. Projected to score 112.2, they scored 93 (−19.2 points, 17% under); projected to allow 109.4, they allowed 76 (−33.4 points, 31% under).

Blue came in with a 7% above average attack and a 12% leakier than average defense (0-2, 84 scored and 95.5 allowed a game over 2 games), worth about 14 and 14 games of evidence. Projected to score 109.4, they scored 76 (−33.4 points, 31% under); projected to allow 112.2, they allowed 93 (−19.2 points, 17% under).

The bigger miss was Blue's scoring (-33.4 points against projection); both sides underscored their projections, so the game ran colder than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 169 against 221.6 projected (-52.6), about the 1st percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±16).

Margin: Vipers by 17 against Vipers by 2.9 projected, about the 12th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An outlier: the simulations had a result this far off less than about 5% of the time, which usually means an input was wrong or missing, not just bad luck.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection missed by a lot, so those flags likely mattered here.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.763 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -14.1 points. It counts toward Hoops+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Hoops+ learning switches on at 20 graded games (18 so far).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 14.1 points), no bet.
